note: Reviewed inputs of scripts/features/feature_schema.py. Controls and fields come from the frozen identity seeds in dbt/seeds/features; this file names only what no seed holds: the kind of a key when it is not a number, the field lists the models write in SQL, and the mask each family takes. The last five lists add the history fields of the restricted earlier-outcome table and the log, change, ordinal and computed keys of a control (the generator also writes dbt/seeds/features/derived_fields.csv from them, which tells the long models which rows to write); every entry carries a reason. Change it by review, then run python -m scripts.features.feature_schema generate.

Impact file rule code: the urban or rural geography is a code

Change-of-ownership types (text) and the count of events (number)

log_fields.reason: Minutes in the emergency department (OP_18b) are skewed to the right; the log is the form m1 uses (design 2.11)
Total discharges are a volume count that spans orders of magnitude (design 2.11)
Operating expense per discharge is a size ratio that spans orders of magnitude (design 2.11)

change_fields.reason: FTE per bed: the change from the previous report for m6 and m2 (design 2.10)
Occupancy: the change from the previous report for m6 and m2 (design 2.10)

ordinal_fields.reason: Emergency department volume as the ordered levels low, medium, high and very high (1 to 4) for m4 (design 2.11)
The rural-urban continuum code as an ordered number from 1 to 9 for m4 (design 2.11)

computed_fields.reason: Population density is the natural log of the SVI population over the SVI area in square miles (design 2.11)
Whether any change of ownership happened in the prior 12 months, 0 or 1, for m6 (design 2.6)

masks.own_snapshot_state: state_source = 'pos_own': the state comes from the window's own POS snapshot, which ends in the 12 months before the window start
masks.own_snapshot_county: county_source = 'pos_own': the county comes from the own snapshot (its HUD fill uses the quarter in force at the snapshot's own period end)
masks.own_snapshot_classification: classification_source = 'pos_own': the provider subtype and control type come from the own snapshot
masks.county_family: county_source = 'pos_own' and no planning region: a Connecticut window with any HUD planning region is masked even with a complete own snapshot
masks.ruca_zip: the spine ZIP equals the first five characters of the own snapshot's ZIP
